title: signature request
description: Present lane. The wallet signs `object` under a stored signing grant whose channel set covers (trusted page origin, audience); otherwise `no_grant`. The card renders the typed object; there is no free-text summary. A filed form needs protocol §5 labeled door 4 and is not specified.

object.description: The typed envelope to sign (for SBO: the action envelope). Rendered field by field.

$comment: Artefact: { signature: JWS over object, presentation: access_cert~assertion~warrant~config_cert } — the assertion carries req_origin (protocol §6.6 invariant 13).
